what: Correction to cargo's done note on 00864 (speed-sol-core, plane loop): item (3) said blaze_graph::pool::submit boxes each job; it does not, jobs go in pooled cells (pool.rs ~L200-260, take_cell/give_back). The alloc-count test through serve/plane.rs Threads is still unwritten, because a cell is given back to the cache of the worker that ran it, not of the daemon's loop thread that submitted it, so it is unclear whether a warm submit from a thread outside the pool allocates nothing. Say whether it does (or make it so); then cargo adds `a warm task through Threads allocates nothing` in serve/plane.rs's tests.
